## Install

Unity **6000.6** or later (the `Unity.Loading` content directory API). No other dependencies.

*Window > Package Manager > + > Add package from git URL...*

```
https://github.com/xpTURN/ContentLink.git?path=/com.xpTURN.ContentLink#__TAG__
```

Or in `Packages/manifest.json`:

```json
"com.xpturn.contentlink": "https://github.com/xpTURN/ContentLink.git?path=/com.xpTURN.ContentLink#__TAG__"
```
